body:
## Updates:
- #0e1b12d: Integrated JSound into LWJGL (by @ShirosakiMio)

## Changes:
- #1797: Limit joystick resize via drag handle to the size allowed by properties (by @youfeng11)
- #1799: Increased polling sample rate for joystick in controller mapping mode, and normalized offsets by actual interval (by @MovTery)

## Fixes:
- #1789: CurseForge downloads failing (by @MovTery)
- #1793: Window size oscillation in picture-in-picture/split-screen mode causing severe screen flickering (by @MovTery)
- #1793: Control layout not functioning properly when window size changes (by @MovTery)
- #1794: Keep-alive foreground service startup timeout causing game process crash (by @MovTery)
- #1795: Single click on hotbar slot triggering the switch key twice (by @MovTery)
- #1798: ENOENT error when saving control layout due to external storage issues (by @MovTery)
